abstract: This field experiment examines the effects of generative AI on labour productivity at Ant Group. In September 2023, Ant Group introduced CodeFuse, an LLM designed to assist programmer teams with coding. One group of programmers used CodeFuse while a control group was not informed about it. The study found productivity (measured by lines of code) increased by 55% for the treatment group, with approximately one third directly attributable to AI-generated code.
keyFindings: Productivity (lines of code produced) increased by 55% for programmers using the CodeFuse LLM
Approximately one third of the productivity increase was directly attributable to code generated by the LLM
Productivity gains were statistically significant only among entry-level or junior staff
The impact on more senior employees was not statistically significant, primarily because senior programmers used gen AI less frequently
When senior programmers did use gen AI, they found the suggestions useful
methodology: Field experiment at Ant Group leveraging the natural introduction of CodeFuse in September 2023. Treatment group: programmers who used CodeFuse. Control group: comparable employees who were not informed about the tool. Productivity measured by lines of code produced.
qualifiers: Lines of code is a contested productivity metric. Results are from a single firm (Ant Group) in China, which may not generalize to other contexts. Senior programmer results were not statistically significant.
